label: Alternate: reserve and infrastructure shortfall shared across cropping, pasture and non-agricultural land
description: An alternate to 2025-resilience, not a later layer: the data layers are those of 2025-resilience and the change is the method module reserve-pro-rata (methods/reserve-pro-rata/method.json). A change to the method (three formulas in Settings!C55:E55). The workbook meets any shortfall of reserve and infrastructure land from non-agricultural land first, then pasture, then cropping, so a 30% reserve costs Australia nothing; here the shortfall is shared by cropping, pasture and non-agricultural land in proportion to their areas, in the sense of a reserve that is representative of the land (the Kunming-Montreal Target 3 asks for ecologically representative protected areas). Regions whose existing reserve already meets the setting are unchanged; the result falls where the reserve and infrastructure settings exceed the existing reserve.
